mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist with minimal systemic absorption when applied topically; fluoxetine may have additive CNS depressant effects, though ophthalmic brimonidine systemic exposure is generally insufficient to cause significant interaction.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation or CNS depression; brimonidine ophthalmic is generally safe to use concurrently with fluoxetine due to limited systemic bioavailability.
